questions.question: Explain why the tens row of 3 408 × 125 starts with a zero.
questions.expected_answer: The 2 in 125 stands for 20, so we need 3 408 × 20, not 3 408 × 2. The zero moves every digit one place left, which multiplies by 10, so the row is 68 160.

questions.question: Estimate 2 006 × 304, then work out the exact answer.
questions.expected_answer: Estimate: 2 000 × 300 = 600 000. Exact: 2 006 × 4 = 8 024 and 2 006 × 300 = 601 800, so the answer is 609 824, which is close to the estimate.
